ink.$description: Ink — All text, hairline borders, nav dividers, the structural skeleton of the page

ash.$description: Ash — Email link, secondary metadata text

paper.$description: Paper — Page background, card surfaces — the unbroken gallery wall

crimson-pop.$description: Crimson Pop — Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

bubblegum.$description: Bubblegum — Illustration surface — flat shapes and product packaging accents

cotton-candy.$description: Cotton Candy — Illustration surface — character skin, hair, soft fills

sour-grape.$description: Sour Grape — Illustration surface and link hover highlight — bright magenta accent within artwork

pool-blue.$description: Pool Blue — Illustration surface — ice, sky, cooling tones in product photography context

ice-blue.$description: Ice Blue — Illustration surface — soft blue fills, atmospheric tones

acid-green.$description: Acid Green — Illustration accent — rare punctuation green in character and product art

helvetica-now.$description: The single typeface for everything: nav links, body, project titles, labels. The 600 weight appears only for project section headers; everything else stays at 400. The uppercase letter-spacing (0.0420em) is reserved for the smallest caption-like text — it reads as a label tag, not body copy

gtstandard-m.$description: GTStandard-M — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
